text:
maria: CI image push failing for PR 6291 after Dockerfile refactor. job 'build-and-push' errors with denied / auth messages and then some disk errors. attaching logs below.

ci-bot: https://ci.internal.redwood.dev/builds/62219 (build-and-push)

maria: log snippet:
```
> > Pushing image to registry.redwood.local/team/service:pr-6291
> Error: failed to push to registry: denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> remote: write /var/lib/docker/aufs/layers: no space left on device
> error: failed to solve: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unexpected status: 401 Unauthorized
```

aj: hmmm two different failure modes in one run. I suspect cache-from + reused runner layers. Also org auth for the registry was tightened last week. I'll look at the workflow auth and the runner cleanup settings.

ethan: i can try a manual push if you give me the built image tar or the tag. if it succeeds we'll know it's CI token issue.

maria: trying to export image now, will upload. (small delay)

aj: quick check — which buildx action version are we on? I saw an upgrade in PR 6270. That PR also added `--cache-from` to speed builds.

maria: yep 6270 changed caching. can we bisect to confirm?

ci-bot: workspace info: runner used: self-hosted-linux-06, reuse workspace: true, docker version: 20.10.22

aj: reuse workspace + cache-from is a red flag. if old cached layers reference manifests that the current workflow token can't fetch, push may fail with denied. the disk full message could be from the runner's leftover layers during attempted pull.

sre-oncall: checked registry quotas & audit logs — no global quota issues. there are a handful of package writes failing with 401 from our CI user. Looks like the repo-level policy now requires a PAT with write:packages. GITHUB_TOKEN doesn't have that cross-repo scope.

ethan: manual push with my PAT succeeded for the same tag. so it's definitely token scope.

maria: plan proposal: 1) temporarily revert the cache-related Dockerfile/workflow change in PR 6291 to unblock main; 2) update build-and-push workflow to use an org PAT (secret: CI_REGISTRY_PAT) for writes; 3) add runner cleanup to avoid stale layers; 4) follow up with security to see if we can allow GITHUB_TOKEN for CI jobs.

aj: +1. quick mitigation: remove `--cache-from` and force fresh runner run. i'll push a tiny workflow-only PR to remove cache-from and set runs-on: ubuntu-latest (fresh runner) to confirm.

maria: ok @aj please do that. if the push still errors after that we will revert the Dockerfile change.

ci-bot: Rebuild triggered by maria: https://ci.internal.redwood.dev/builds/62220 (job started)

ci-bot: Build finished: image build SUCCESS, push FAILED (denied: requested access to the resource is denied)

aj: confirmed: same denied error even on fresh runner. most likely token scope. i'll open PR to switch to CI_REGISTRY_PAT and update secret perms.

ethan: opening ticket for org secret & policy discussion so we don't retain broad PATs. i'll reference this thread.

sre-oncall: marking as sev3 for now since this blocks merges that change images. escalation path documented in SRE runbook.

maria: assigning to @aj to land workflow change. @aj can you add a brief note in PR description about why PAT is necessary and include rollback steps? :pray:

aj: on it, expect PR in ~20-30m. will trigger a rerun once secrets are in place.

maria: thanks everyone. keeping updates in this thread.
